_comment: v16 defaults (DSA_V16_EAGER=1, DSA_V16_PDS_HOIST=1). Reference build = final.py (trace-free canonical) -- capture it with compile_capture.py --impl final and pass as --reference-capture. G2: zero-delta hard gate on W16/W17/W18; W19 gains a small commit loop and must stay zero STL/LDL (analyzer treats unknown roles as zero-delta via G2_ALLOWED_DELTAS.get default; explicit W19 pin below). Dual-0 build must show zero drift vs the final reference in every role window. Run all four env combos through compile before any B200 time. L2X-only clauses (MATH_S2G, G2S_*) removed -- v16 has no L2X; G3 falls back to analyzer defaults (final-era math publish). REFERENCE_ROLE_LOCAL_TOTALS initial pin carries the v12-lineage values (final is the same program modulo the trace strip); if the final capture disagrees, update these three numbers from the capture and rerun -- compile-only, no GPU cost.
